notes: Volume holds: p1 a typed one-page summary by province/agrupación (T only); pp2-11 a clean typed table 'ELECCION DE DIPUTADOS - 1957' with party votes V/M/T, válidos, nulos, votantes, inscritos, cifra repartidora per agrupación (rows: provinces, the three Santiago districts, the four departments of the 8a agrupación, Ñuble split in two) and TOTAL DEL PAIS; pp13-16 the list of agrupaciones and seats; pp17-60 degraded commune-level tables (printed pages 59-102) for agrupaciones 1-16 only; pp61-62 part 2 and accounting of a summary by agrupación (part 1, printed p.134, and printed pp.103-133 are missing); pp63-68 elected deputies; p69 elected by party (total 147); p70 women candidates. Grouping figures were transcribed from pp2-11 (legible), cross-checked against the commune tables for Tarapacá and against p1/p61/p62; all agrupaciones close (party T sum = válidos, válidos + nulos = votantes) except the printed slips noted per contest. Contest numbers follow the agrupación ordinals of pp13-15; the 7a agrupación (Santiago) is split into three districts numbered 71, 72, 73. The national 'parties' are the TOTAL DEL PAIS row (p3/5/7/9), with NACIONAL CRISTIANO 9.085 and NACIONAL 37.975 as printed. Elected names are typed in capitals on a poor scan; several were partly illegible and were completed from the legible letters (uncertain: COQUIMBO 'JUAN PEÑAFIEL ILLANES', 'HUGO ZEPEDA BARRIOS'; VALPARAISO 'JOAQUIN MORANO LILLO', 'CARLOS MUÑOS HORZ'; 1er. distrito nos. 7-8 marked [ilegible]). Election day from p69.
